slice: rmcp-v3.1.4 stock tasks/update and input-request semantics

finding.task_demo_dispatch: ServerHandler::update_task forwards request.input_responses directly to TaskManager::update_task; no additional validation/redrive is present in the demo handler.
finding.input_required_status: TaskManager derives input_required from pending_inputs being nonempty. TaskContext::request_input inserts a unique key into pending_inputs and waits on an in-memory oneshot receiver.
finding.outstanding_key_membership: TaskManager::update_task only removes and sends responses for keys currently present in pending_inputs, but unknown/already-answered/superseded keys are silently ignored rather than rejected. Partial response sets are accepted.
finding.duplicate_response_handling: After the first accepted response removes a pending key, later responses for that key are ignored. request_input separately forbids reusing a key over the task lifetime via used_input_keys.
finding.durable_post_update_redrive: Absent in the stock path examined. Accepted responses are delivered to the currently running operation through process-memory tokio oneshot channels; no durable accepted-response state, generation CAS, or persistent redrive outbox is written by TaskManager::update_task.
finding.restart_scope: TaskManager state is process-local Arc<Mutex<...>>; therefore this stock path does not provide server-restart task/input-response durability.

minimal_custom_seam: Keep stock wire types/ServerHandler method signatures, but back update_task with an application-owned persistent task record. Validate task generation and input_required/current outstanding-key subset atomically, persist accepted responses, and create a redrive outbox atomically when the final outstanding response is accepted. Map unknown task/generation/conflict/invalid-key conditions explicitly instead of relying on stock ignore semantics. External-effect execution remains out of this slice.
tested_scope: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 example handler and TaskManager source only; no claim about unretrieved custom handlers or future releases.
residual_dependency_note: The application-owned persistent store/redriver and effect-side idempotency/fencing are still unresolved Phase-1 children; this finding does not accept them as a handoff.
conflict_check: Own-state/public-source-only slice; no O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger or other-role semantic input used.
exact_continuation: Next invocation only: pin rmcp-v3.1.4 model and ServerHandler error surfaces used by tasks/update. Determine the exact ErrorData code/constructor mapping available for unknown task, stale generation/intent conflict, non-input_required update, and non-outstanding response key in a custom persistent handler, without inventing fields or compiling. Persist a source-qualified mapping candidate and stop after durable checkpoint; do not enter external-effect execution.
